fix.pr_body:
## What was wrong

Flask-Session was sending a `Set-Cookie` header with every response, including static asset responses (CSS, JS, images, etc.). This is wasteful and was the root cause of a prior incident where an `@lru_cache` on a static-file route caused users to see each other's sessions — because the session cookie was being attached to those responses at all.

## What changed

`decksite/main.py` — two additions:

1. **`before_request`**: Added `session.modified = False` in the `else` branch of the existing `simple_paths` check. This tells Flask-Session not to persist or refresh the session for static asset requests, covering the common case where `SESSION_REFRESH_EACH_REQUEST` is the driver.

2. **`after_request`**: Activated the previously-commented-out stub and added a `response.headers.remove('Set-Cookie')` guard for any path under `APP.static_url_path`. This belt-and-suspenders approach handles edge cases (e.g. a permanent session with `SESSION_REFRESH_EACH_REQUEST=True`) that `session.modified = False` alone would not cover, and is the approach recommended by the linked Stack Overflow answer in the issue comments.

## Validation

- `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` — passed (exit 0)
- `uv run --frozen python dev.py unit` — 848 passed, 1 skipped, 89 deselected

Fixes #7461
fix.pr_title: Avoid sending Set-Cookie header with static assets (#7461)

No commit has ever set session.modified in decksite — the fix has not been applied

triage.fix_sketch: In decksite/main.py:before_request(), inside the block that already identifies static paths (simple_paths list), add 'session.modified = False' when the request path matches a simple_path prefix. This prevents Flask-Session from touching the session cookie for asset requests. The change is 1-2 lines in decksite/main.py. Optionally add an after_request hook that strips Set-Cookie from responses whose request.path starts with APP.static_url_path for belt-and-suspenders coverage.
triage.notes: The lru_cache/logged-in-as-wrong-person incident mentioned in comments reinforces the value of keeping session completely out of static responses. The fix is minimal and isolated to decksite/main.py:before_request.
